evals.name: fridge-flyer
evals.prompt: Make a one-page flyer for my fridge magnet: home tech help in Las Vegas, email michael.audette@audetteit.com.
evals.expected_output: A printable one-page HTML flyer in the room-guide style (Red Hat type, black rules, one yellow mark, logo), first-person copy using only confirmed facts, no phone number or prices.

evals.name: home-networks-page
evals.prompt: Add a new page to the site called 'Home networks' about network design and wifi coverage.
evals.expected_output: An audetteit.com page using the exact head block and site components, its Markdown twin, and the list of the other repo places to update (MARKDOWN_PAGES, run_worker_first, sitemap, llms.txt, _headers, build-llms.py).

evals.name: cracked-screen-email
evals.prompt: Write a short reply email to someone asking if I can fix their cracked iPhone screen.
evals.expected_output: A short, kind first-person reply that says no to physical phone repairs and offers setup/settings help instead. No prices, no phone number, signed Michael.

evals.name: helpdesk-status-page
evals.prompt: Design a status page for the self-hosted help desk (#44) that matches the site.
evals.expected_output: An HTML status page in the room-guide style using only palette tokens, status shown as word plus shape, no fake 'all systems operational' claims (real checks with last-checked times or clear placeholders).

evals.name: google-business-profile
evals.prompt: Draft a Google Business Profile description.
evals.expected_output: A first-person description within Google's 750-character limit, using only confirmed facts (Las Vegas or remote, everyday list, bigger jobs, quote before work), no emoji, no invented claims.
